context_for_next_testing_agent: Sprint 4 (FINAL) Phase 2 Culinary Intelligence features complete. F3: Menu Engineering classifies recipes into 4 quadrants (star/plowhorse/puzzle/dog) based on popularity vs profit. What-If simulator allows testing price/cost changes. F4: Cost Variance compares theoretical vs actual cost from POSTED production batches. Severity bands: <5% ok, 5-10% warn, >10% critical. F5: Plated → Catalog conversion creates new menu in db.menus with source='plated_menu_conversion'. Note: Pame account menus have empty courses (no recipes), so F5 convert returns 400. Demo account has plated menu with recipes for successful conversion testing.
